summary: Sandbach United's preseason is in full swing with an exciting new squad taking shape for the 2026/27 campaign, featuring three brand new kits and several fresh faces alongside a returning player. The Ramblers showed competitive spirit in a recent tight match against St Helens, though they'll be looking to sharpen up their finishing ahead of the season kicking off next week. With promotion in their sights, the club is actively seeking sponsorship partners to support their ambitious plans for the year ahead.
